note: User overrides for the speculative-decoding pair table. Entries here take precedence over the curated table in electron/services/draft-selector.js. Edit by hand to add a custom main/draft combination; restart not required (the selector re-reads this file on every getDraftFor() call).

schema.pairs[].main: Required. Main model id as the orchestrator sees it (matches against payload.model substring).
schema.pairs[].draft: Required. Draft model id; must be loadable by the NPU draft runtime.
schema.pairs[].tokenizerId: Optional. Family tag used by validatePair when tokenizer hashes are unavailable.
schema.pairs[].family: Optional. Display label, used in the dashboard.
schema.pairs[].score: Optional. 0.0..1.0 -- 1.0 = drop-in pair, 0.7 = adapter required, < 0.5 = unsupported.
